NOTE

The following notes are meant to assist in the use of classes B01 - B09; they must not be read as modifying in any way the elaborations.
In this sub-section, the separation of different materials, e.g. of different matter, size, or state, is predominantly found in the following subclasses:
B01D
B03B, B03C, B03D
B04B, B04C
B07B, B07C
The classifying characteristics of these subclasses are:
the physical state of the matter to be separated
the principle of the process used
particular kinds of apparatus The first of these characteristics involves six different aspects, assembled in three groups.
liquid/liquid or liquid/gas and gas/gas
solid/liquid or solid/gas
solid/solid
Theses subclasses are to be used according to the following general rules:
B01D is the most general class as far as separation other than solids from solids is concerned.
Apparatus for separating solids from solids are covered by B03B when the process concerned is regarded as the equivalent of "washing" in the sense of the mining art, even if such apparatus is a pneumatic one, especially pneumatic tables or jigs. Screens PER SE are not covered by this subclass but are classified in B07B, even if they are being used in a wet process. All other apparatus for the separation of solids from solids according to dry methods are classified in B07B.
If the separation takes place as a result of the detection or measurement of some feature of the material or articles to be sorted it is classified in B07C.
It should also be noted that the separation of isotopes of the same chemical element is covered by B01D59/00, whatever process or apparatus is employed.

B65G15/00.en: Conveyors having endless load-conveying surfaces, i.e. belts and like continuous members, to which tractive effort is transmitted by means other than endless driving elements of similar configuration (having load-conveying surfaces formed by interconnected longitudinal links B65G17/06)

B65G15/005.ja: ｛一本のロープで形成される面｝
B65G15/005.en: {the surface being formed by one rope}

B65G15/02.ja: 円形弧中で運搬するためのもの
B65G15/02.en: for conveying in a circular arc

B65G15/04.ja: 荷物がエンドレスな面の下部走行路により運搬されるもの
B65G15/04.en: the load being carried on the lower run of the endless surface

B65G15/06.ja: 同一平面で互いに平行の位置にあるエンドレス面が逆の方向に動く部分をもつもの
B65G15/06.en: with oppositely-moving parts of the endless surface located in the same plane and parallel to one another

B65G15/08.ja: 荷運び面が凹面または管状に形づけられているもの；例．樋状の形をしているベルト
B65G15/08.en: the load-carrying surface being formed by a concave or tubular belt, e.g. a belt forming a trough

B65G15/105.ja: ｛二本以上のロープにより形成される面｝

B65G15/16.ja: 補助ベルトと主ベルト間で運ばれるもの

B65G15/18.en: the belts being sealed at their edges

B65G15/20.ja: 相並んで配列されたもの，例．平らな物品をたてた状態で運搬するためのもの（シートまたはそのような薄い平らな物品の輸送Ｂ６５Ｈ）
B65G15/20.en: arranged side by side, e.g. for conveyance of flat articles in vertical position

B65G15/22.ja: 一連の協働するユニットよりなるもの
B65G15/22.en: comprising a series of co-operating units

B65G15/26.ja: 可伸性のもの，例．入れ子式のもの　｛荷物運搬具の長さ又は構成の調整　Ｂ６５Ｇ２１／１４｝
B65G15/26.en: extensible, e.g. telescopic {(adjustment of length or configuration of load-carrier B65G21/14)}

B65G15/28.ja: 単一な平ベルトにより形成されている荷運搬帯をもつコンベヤで他の分類に属さないもの

B65G15/30.ja: ベルトまたは類似のエンドレス荷運搬具（レールまたはそのようなものと協働するものＢ６５Ｇ２１／２２；ローラをもつものＢ６５Ｇ３９／２０；ベルト一般Ｆ１６Ｇ）　｛ベルト掛止め　Ｆ１６Ｇ３／００｝

B65G15/34.en: with reinforcing layers, e.g. of fabric

B65G15/36.ja: その層にロープ，チェーン，または圧延鉄板が組み込まれているもの
B65G15/36.en: the layers incorporating ropes, chains, or rolled steel sections

B65G15/38.ja: 耐炎層，例．アスベスト，ガラス層，をもつもの
B65G15/38.en: with flame-resistant layers, e.g. of asbestos, glass

B65G15/40.ja: 樋状または管状のもの；樋状にするのを容易にするジヨイントで形成されているもの

B65G15/46.ja: 案内が形成されているベルト

B65G15/50.ja: エンドレス荷運搬帯が一連の平行ロープまたはベルト状のものよりなるもの
B65G15/50.en: Endless load-carriers consisting of a series of parallel ropes or belt strips

B65G15/52.ja: トラバーススラットにより相互に連結されているもの

B65G15/54.ja: エンドレス荷運搬帯が織り合わされたロープまたはワイヤーよりできているもの
B65G15/54.en: Endless load-carriers made of interwoven ropes or wires

B65G15/56.ja: 縁に保護または補強手段をもつもの

B65G15/58.ja: 固定位置に荷を保持または止めておく手段をもつもの，例．磁石
B65G15/58.en: with means for holding or retaining the loads in fixed position, e.g. magnetic

B65G15/60.ja: ベルトの支持またはガイド装置，例．流体の噴射によるもの（ローラの構成またはローラの支持Ｂ６５Ｇ３９／００　｛Ｆ１６Ｃ１３／００｝）
B65G15/60.en: Arrangements for supporting or guiding belts, e.g. by fluid jets

B65G15/62.ja: ベルトを滑らすためのガイド

B65G15/64.ja: ベルトの位置を自動的に維持するためのもの
B65G15/64.en: for automatically maintaining the position of the belts

B65G17/00.en: Conveyors having an endless traction element, e.g. a chain, transmitting movement to a continuous or substantially-continuous load-carrying surface or to a series of individual load-carriers; Endless-chain conveyors in which the chains form the load-carrying surface

B65G17/005.en: {comprising individual load carriers which are movably mounted (B65G17/16 takes precedence)}

B65G17/007.ja: ｛コンベヤの下部走行路又は上部と下部両走行路で荷を運ぶためのもの｝
B65G17/007.en: {for conveying the load on the lower run or on both upper and lower runs of the conveyor}

B65G17/02.ja: 牽引要素に取付けまたは乗せた荷運搬ベルトよりなるもの
B65G17/02.en: comprising a load-carrying belt attached to or resting on the traction element

B65G17/064.en: {the profiles, rods, bars, rollers or the like being interconnected by a mesh or grid-like structure}

B65G17/065.ja: ｛一つの牽引要素に取り付けられる板体又は板面により形成される荷運搬面｝
B65G17/065.en: {the load carrying surface being formed by plates or platforms attached to a single traction element}

B65G17/066.ja: ｛特に曲路に沿って行くように適合されたもの　（個々の荷運搬具のためのものＢ６５Ｇ１７／２２）｝
B65G17/066.en: {specially adapted to follow a curved path (for individual load carriers B65G17/22)}

B65G17/067.ja: ｛一つ以上の牽引要素に取り付けられる板体又は板面により形成される荷運搬面｝
B65G17/067.en: {the load carrying surface being formed by plates or platforms attached to more than one traction element}

B65G17/068.ja: ｛特に曲路に沿って行くように適合されたもの　（個々の荷運搬具のためのものＢ６５Ｇ１７／２２）｝
B65G17/068.en: {specially adapted to follow a curved path (for individual load carriers B65G17/22)}

B65G17/08.ja: その面が牽引要素で形成されているもの
B65G17/08.en: the surface being formed by the traction element

B65G17/083.ja: ｛外形素材，ロッド，棒材，ローラ等に形成される面｝
B65G17/083.en: {the surface being formed by profiles, rods, bars, rollers or the like}

B65G17/086.ja: ｛特に曲路に沿って行くように適合されたもの　（個々の荷運搬具のためのものＢ６５Ｇ１７／２２）｝
B65G17/086.en: {specially adapted to follow a curved path (for individual load carriers B65G17/22)}

B65G17/10.ja: その面が長手方向に樋の形をしたもの
B65G17/10.en: the surface forming a longitudinal trough

B65G17/12.en: comprising a series of individual load-carriers fixed, or normally fixed, relative to traction element

B65G17/123.ja: ｛少なくともコンベヤ運転の一部で荷運搬具を水平に保つよう配列されるもの｝

B65G17/14.ja: 牽引要素に対して間隔をあけた二つの連結部をもつもの
B65G17/14.en: with two spaced connections to traction element

B65G17/16.ja: 枢着された個々の荷運搬器よりなるもの，例．自由揺動するもの（荷をあけるために荷運搬器を転倒しまたは傾けるガイド　｛Ｂ６５Ｇ４７／３８；　Ｂ６５Ｇ１７／２０　が優先｝）

B65G17/18.en: and move in contact with a guiding surface

B65G17/20.ja: 高架牽引チェーンから吊り下げられた荷運搬器よりなるもの
B65G17/20.en: comprising load-carriers suspended from overhead traction chains

B65G17/28.en: extensible, e.g. telescopic {(adjustment of length or configuration of traction element B65G21/14)}

B65G17/34.en: having flat surfaces, e.g. platforms, grids, forks

B65G17/345.en: {the surfaces being equipped with a conveyor}

B65G17/38.en: Chains or like traction elements (drive chains F16G13/00); Connections between traction elements and load-carriers

B65G17/385.ja: ｛立体的曲路に続くよう適合されるもの｝

B65G17/42.ja: 荷運搬器の牽引要素への取り付け
B65G17/42.en: Attaching load carriers to traction elements

B65G17/48.en: Controlling attitudes of load-carriers during movement ({B65G17/18 takes precedence;} guides B65G21/20; inverting or tilting load carriers to discharge contents B65G47/38)

B65G19/10.en: and attached to a pair of belts, ropes or chains
